title: 1.1.0 — Vehicle setup & reliability
status: Release candidate — beta build 16 / final build 17
changes: Direct make/model fields with a small offline autocomplete catalogue, custom entries, optional one/two-photo AI identification and a skip path. AI runs online through the backend.
Road-vehicle categories including SUVs, motorcycles, scooters, pickups, vans, trucks and buses. Diagnostic assistance does not imply verified OBD compatibility.
Unknown year, powertrain, mileage and service details remain unknown. VIN stays optional, local and editable.
Vehicle details can be edited later and the selected vehicle is restored after restart.
Clearer diagnosis choices, privacy and permission explanations, compatibility guidance, and in-app release notes.
More time for older Bluetooth adapters to connect and paired-device fallback when discovery fails.
Includes the Billing 9.1.0 and verified offline purchase-cache improvements introduced in v15.
Photo recognition and server purchase checks require the matching updated backend. Availability on Google Play depends on rollout.

title: 1.0.5 — Billing & offline paid access
status: Signed v15 build prepared; store rollout not confirmed
changes: Upgraded RevenueCat Flutter SDK to 11.0.0 and Google Play Billing to 9.1.0.
Store/network failures preserve previously verified paid access within a bounded offline window.
Pro cache grace is limited to three days; Emergency Pass stays limited to 48 hours from purchase.
Pending payments do not grant new access; startup no longer waits for product or quota requests.
Restored the approved icon and splash artwork and preserved optional VIN persistence.
